claim.claim-text: 1. A snap-acting hinge (1) with damped closure and opening angle of more than 90°, which comprises

2. The hinge (1) according to claim 1, characterized in that it comprises at least one bracket (29) for connecting said damping means (14) to said fixing plate (8) which is substantially L-shaped and is constituted by a first portion and a second portion which are mutually connected by way of a connecting region.

3. The hinge (1) according to claim 1 or 2, having at least one L-shaped bracket (29) of the hinge (1) has the first portion hinged to the fixing plate (8) about a first pivot (30), for connecting the damping means (14) to said fixing plate (8), and wherein the connecting region between the first and second portions of the bracket (29) is hinged to the second lever (5) about a second pivot (31), the second portion being hinged to said damping means (14) about a third pivot (32).
4. The hinge (1) according to claim 3, characterized in that said third pivot (32) is arranged so as to protrude with respect to said second lever (5) toward said first quadrilateral (2).
5. The hinge (1) according to claim 3 or 4, characterized in that said first pivot (30) coincides with the pivot (21) for hinging said second lever (5) to said fixing plate (8).

6. The hinge (1) according to one of the claims 1-3, characterized in that it comprises at least one rod (33) for connecting said damping means (14) to said first lever (4), which is articulated about the pivots (16, 17) for hinging said first lever (4) to said coupling plate (6) and to said second lever (5) and is associated with a fourth pivot (34) for articulating said damping means (14).

7. The hinge (1) according to claim 6, characterized in that said fourth pivot (34) is arranged so as to protrude with respect to the pivot (17) for hinging said first and second levers (4, 5) toward said second quadrilateral (3)

8. The hinge (1) according to one of the claims 1-7, characterized in that said damping means (14) comprise a piston that can slide within a hollow body (35) and is associated with a stem (36) that protrudes from said body.
9. The hinge (1) according to any of the claims 3-8, characterized in that said stem (36) is hinged about said third pivot (32) and said hollow body (35) is hinged about said fourth pivot (34).

10. The hinge (1) according to any of the claims 1-9, characterized in that said first elastic means (12) comprise at least one first compression spring (24) that acts between said second lever (5) and a first arm (15) of said first quadrilateral (2) which is interposed between said coupling plate (6) and said second lever.

11. The hinge (1) according to any of the claims 1-10, characterized in that said second elastic means (13) comprise at least one second compression spring (27) that acts between said fixing plate (8) and a second arm (20) of said second quadrilateral (3), which is adjacent to said spring.

12. The hinge (1) of any of the claims 2-11, characterized in that said second portion of the bracket (29) protrudes with respect to said second lever (5) toward said first quadrilateral (2) and carries the third pivot (32) about which said the damping means (14) are hinged.

13. The hinge of any of the claims 6-12, characterized in that said at least one rod (33) comprises a portion that protrudes with respect to the pivot (17) toward the second quadrilateral (3) and which carries the articulation pivot (34) about which said damping means (14) are articulated.

14. The hinge of any of the claims 1-13, wherein when the coupling plate (6) is connected in a horizontal lower region of an upper element that defines a compartment of a cupboard or the like and the fixing plate (8) is connected internally to a door leaf that vertically closes said compartment, upon transition between a closed configuration of the hinge and an open configuration thereof, the levers of said first and second articulated quadrilaterals (2, 3) of the hinge (1) rotate about respective horizontal axes, keeping themselves on an ideal vertical plane, and the movable element (101) also rotates about a horizontal axis, positioned at a corresponding upper edge thereof, up to a position in which the movable element (101) is above a horizontal level of the fixed portion (100) and at an upward angle with respect to said horizontal level.
